description: This Java source file defines the class OfbizContentAltUrlTransforms, implementing a FreeMarker TemplateTransformModel. It generates alternative URLs for content based on content IDs, potentially using database lookups to fetch URL info, or constructing URLs based on request context. It appears to be part of the OFBiz framework's content web application, specifically related to FreeMarker template transformations.

classes.name: OfbizContentAltUrlTransforms
classes.description: A FreeMarker template transform class that generates alternative URLs for content items based on content IDs. It performs database queries to retrieve URL info or constructs URLs from request context and provided parameters.

methods.name: getStringArg
methods.description: Retrieves a string argument from the arguments map, handling various FreeMarker types such as SimpleScalar, GenericObjectModel, and SimpleNumber.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Provides a custom Writer for FreeMarker processing that captures and processes the output, integrating variables 'request' and 'response', and generating URLs based on contentId and viewContent.

methods.name: makeContentAltUrl
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve an alternative URL for the given contentId from the database; if unavailable, constructs a default URL based on request context and viewContent.

methods.name: makeContentUrl
methods.description: Constructs a default content URL based on the request context, content ID, and view content, appending query parameters as needed.
